name: oct-analyzer-workspace
description: Root workspace to run frontend and backend concurrently

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix web-app/frontend" "PYTHONPATH=web-app uv run python -m uvicorn backend.oct_analyzer.api:app --reload --port 8000" "PYTHONPATH=web-app uv run celery -A backend.oct_analyzer.celery_app worker --pool=solo --loglevel=info"
